messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - unusual auth rate spike on auth-proxy-prod. Large distributed 401s from many IPs. Possible credential stuffing. Alert: https://obs.redwood/alerts/5995004321 :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: taking this. spinning up bridge, collecting logs. @carla.sec can you join?

carla.sec: on it. quick scan shows ~120 unique IPs, concentrated in APAC and EU. No obvious S3 exfil alerts yet. Looks like spray, not replay.

alice.dev: seeing lots of hits to /v1/session and /v1/login. user-agent variance and rapid user enumeration patterns. rate limiter currently not kicking until 50r/m.

ben.ops: pushing a temporary WAF block for the top offending ranges: 35.204.0.0/16 and 142.251.0.0/16 for 10m, will monitor.

mike-support: any visible customer impact? got a CS ticket about login errors for a big customer.

carla.sec: checking logs for token strings or PII. so far failures look like bad creds, not token misuse. correlating with last 24h deploys.

oncall-sre: let's avoid immediate mass key rotation. plan: block ranges, enable captcha/slowdown, rotate any service keys if we find them in cleartext, and invalidate suspicious sessions for affected tenants.

alice.dev: debug command I ran:
```
# tail recent 401s from auth-proxy pods
kubectl logs -l app=auth-proxy -n prod | grep ' 401 ' | tail -n 200
```

carla.sec: recommended short-term actions:
- apply IP blocks (done)
- enable captcha on /v1/session after 5 failed attempts
- audit recent logging changes for redaction gaps
- identify any leaked tokens and revoke if present

oncall-sre: starting canary captcha rollout to 10% of auth-proxy traffic now. will report metrics in 5m.

incident-bot: Incident status set to 'mitigating' by oncall-sre. Pager silence: 15m.

ben.ops: WAF rule active. telemetry shows ~68% drop in suspicious 401s across proxies.

mike-support: creating customer comms draft for affected tenants (acme-inc, datawise). tagging legal for review.

carla.sec: if we find leaked logs containing creds, next steps: KMS key swap, rotate service account keys, revoke refresh tokens for impacted tenants. I'll draft rotation playbook.

alice.dev: note — last night's deploy adjusted auth-proxy debug logging. double-check redaction config, I pushed a quick rollback check.

oncall-sre: assigning action items: @alice.dev check redaction and rollback if needed; @carla.sec lead any rotations; @ben.ops keep monitoring and adjust WAF; @mike-support prepare CS comms.

mike-support: ack. posting draft in #customer-notices and will wait for legal OK.

carla.sec: uploaded initial incident notes and proposed rotation steps: https://docs.redwood/incident/5995004321

oncall-sre: moving team to live bridge for mitigation. ping here if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
